clues: This positively charged protein was discovered in 1869 by a Swiss biochemist who was working with salmon sperm. It is still purified from salmon sperm or testes so the FDA recommends caution with use of this medication in those with fish allergies although cross-reactivity is rare
This protein is combined with insulin to delay the absorption and prolong the effects of insulin

What does NPH stand for? Patients receiving NPH insulin long term may develop antibodies against one component. They are subsequently at much higher risk of adverse reaction when this medication is administered, such as during cardiac bypass surgery or carotid endarterectomy

Willowbrook State School was an overcrowded and underfunded institution for children with intellectual disabilities. Because diseases were already so endemic, researchers justified deliberately exposing newly admitted children to this blood borne disease to better study it. The public outcry led to sweeping reforms and ultimately influenced the creation of IRBs

In the 19th and early 20th century, outbreaks of this disease were linked to receiving vaccines. For example, in 1942, over 50,000 US soldiers developed this disease after receiving the yellow fever vaccine, which contained human serum

Vaccination against this DNA virus made medical history as the first ever anti-cancer vaccine. First deployed universally in Taiwan in 1984, it slashed childhood rates of a specific type of cancer by 75% within 2 decades.
This organ is the driving force behind amphibian metamorphosis. Abnormalities can lead to an inability for tadpoles to transform into frogs
Typically weighing only 25 grams, any organ weighing over 250 grams is defined as 'massive'. The largest removed from a human weighed an astonishing 5.2kg
Although commonly described as butterfly shaped, the name of this is derived from a Greek word (θυρεός) meaning 'shield'
In 1909, a German physician created the first recorded version of this using a ring made of silkworm guts that was placed inside patients

Because the addition of metals was thought to make this more effective, pure silver was later wrapped around the ring, but the silver was absorbed and patients' gums turned bluish-black. This led to the use of other metals such as copper
While other strange shapes were tried like fern, snakes, and stingrays, current devices are in a T-shape and over 99% effective, lasting 3-10 years

Discovered in a soil sample from the jungles of Borneo in 1952, early purifications yielded a brown, crude solution that was nicknamed 'Mississippi mud' before better manufacturing processes were developed
The origins of the medication name are unclear but might come from the English word 'vanquish' or the Latin word for 'vanish' or 'disappear'
Because of poor oral bioavailability, this antibiotic must be given through an IV for extra-intestinal infections.
